title: Continuous deployment from the branch model
description: The `ci` layer: an OWNED GitHub Actions deploy workflow (.github/workflows/deploy.yml) that, on a push to a line the branch model binds with `ci`, runs `nx affected -t deploy` (base = the last successful run, via nx-set-shas; workflow_dispatch scope=all runs run-many) in that line's GitHub environment, authenticated by the active deploy providers (Firebase: keyless Workload Identity Federation) — plus each provider's human-run cloud setup (tools/setup-gcp.sh). Undeclared model or no `ci` binding → no workflow, and says what to do. Never overwrites a file the house did not write, and writes no second workflow where the project already deploys from its own.

layers.description: The layers this run applies — the deploy providers are theirs. Defaults to detecting them.

branchProjection.description: The branch model the caller RESOLVED: its projection as JSON, or 'undeclared'. Passed by house.sh; absent on a direct call, which reads the workspace's .bespunky/branches.json.
